title: Sex & Drugs & Rock & Roll (TV series)
production_companies: FXPCredited as FX Productions for first season
premise_summary: Sex & Drugs & Rock & Roll is an American musical comedy television series created by and starring Denis Leary. The series aired on FX for a total of 20 episodes from July 16, 2015, to September 1, 2016. Following the end of the second season, FX canceled the show.
